get_fold: get train dev and test task id splits for a given phyre evaluation setup and seed
compute_metrics: compute evaluation metrics from a raw simulation log including independent solved by and global solved by
compute_metrics_normalized: compute normalized evaluation metrics from a simulation log divided by the number of tasks
Evaluator: create an Evaluator instance to log simulation attempts and compute AUCCESS metrics for a set of task ids
list_eval_setups: list all registered phyre evaluation setup names as a sorted tuple of strings
